question: What dark form is accessed by resorting to the place of the yogini?
premises: One resorts to the place of the yogini
A dark, black-colored form is present there
This form is the object of focus
inference: Having resorted to the place of the yogini, one engages with the dark, black-colored form.
plain_english: Having resorted to the place of the yogini, one contemplates the dark, black-colored form.
